derivation: P(PreferenceBarrier=Present)=0.3 and P(PriorTreatmentDifficulty=Present)=0.2 are separate synthetic root priors.

Ordered AdherenceDifficulty parents are PreferenceBarrier then PriorTreatmentDifficulty, with Present rows 0.1,0.4,0.7,0.9. P(Present)=0.7*0.8*0.1+0.7*0.2*0.4+0.3*0.8*0.7+0.3*0.2*0.9=0.056+0.056+0.168+0.054=0.334. Parent transposition instead gives 0.304, so this is an order guard.

ResponseReviewFlag NotTriggered equals Adequate=0.46986. TolerabilityReviewFlag Triggered=0.4+(0.6*0.3)=0.58, because the mathematical side-effect distribution is 0.6/0.4 in every established-treatment row.

FunctionalBenefit is 0.7/0.3 in every assessed response row; safety and monitoring root concerns are 0.8/0.2 with corresponding deterministic flags. These are mathematical examples, never patient findings.
Aripiprazole=100% is an explicit synthetic root distribution for computation, not medication selection or evidence clamping. It is not inferred from either context example.

derivation: Medication and TrialDuration synthetic root priors assign 100% to their explicit NoEstablishedTreatment states. This represents a supplied mathematical context, not selecting or discontinuing a medication.

For every parent combination with medication NoEstablishedTreatment, EffectiveExposure and SignificantAntipsychoticSideEffects rows assign 100% NotAssessable. Every source category row assigns100% NotApplicable.

Given EffectiveExposure NotAssessable or TrialDuration NoEstablishedTreatment, SymptomResponse is 100% NotAssessable. FunctionalBenefit and ResponseReviewFlag follow its NotAssessable row; TolerabilityReviewFlag follows side-effect NotAssessable irrespective of PreferenceBarrier. None is an absent/negative finding.
The 21 sentinel marginals therefore each equal 1, all their other states 0. Source-table labels are outside established-treatment comparison here, not Seldom or incidence 0.

UrgentSafetyConcern and MonitoringGap roots retain 80/20 and independent deterministic flags retain 80/20. No-treatment does not impute safe status or complete monitoring; Present/Triggered remains 0.2 in this reference math.
An opposing Aripiprazole/WithinResponseWindow patient projection is provenance only; inference and replay still use evidence={} and the frozen sentinel CPTs. Applicability declaration remains true.
